Variant; the surrounding-confining sense (1Ki 7:15 (variant); 2Ki 5:23 (variant); etc.). 4 occurrences. Standard.

From √tsur (be-strong); the strong-mass rock — most-frequently the divine-fortress-rock metaphor (Deu 32:4 'He is the Rock'; 32:18,30,31; 1Sa 2:2 'no rock like our God'; 2Sa 22:3,32,47; 23:3; Pss 18:3,32,47 [2,31,46]; 19:15 [14]; 28:1; 31:3 [2]; 42:10 [9]; 62:3,7,8 [2,6,7]; 71:3; 73:26 (variant); 78:35; 89:27 [26]; 92:16 [15]; 94:22; 95:1; 144:1; Isa 17:10; 26:4; 30:29; 44:8; 51:1; etc.). 78 occurrences. Standard. Distinguished from H5553 sela ('rock-cliff', the steep-cliff-rock) and H68 even ('stone', the building-block / individual-stone).
Multiple persons (Num 25:15; 31:8; Jos 13:21; 1Chr 8:30; 9:36). 5 occurrences. English convention.
Used (Gen 25:28; 27:3,5,7,19,25,30,31,33; Lev 17:13; Job 38:41 (variant); Pro 12:27; Mic 7:2). 13 occurrences. Standard.
Used (Gen 42:25; 45:21; Ex 12:39; Jos 1:11; 9:11; Jdg 7:8 (variant); 20:10; 1Sa 22:10; 1Ki 5:11 [5:25] (variant); Neh 13:15; Pss 78:25; 132:15). 12 occurrences. Standard.

Used (Jdg 9:36 (variant); Job 40:22 (variant); Jer 6:4 (variant); Eze 31:3,12 (variant)). 4 occurrences. Standard.

Substantive (Gen 1:26,27 (twice); 5:3; 9:6; Num 33:52; 1Sa 6:5,11; 2Ki 11:18; 2Chr 23:17; Pss 39:7 [6]; 73:20; Eze 7:20; 16:17; 23:14; Am 5:26). 17 occurrences. Standard. The most theologically-loaded image-noun: 'in the image of God' (Gen 1:26,27; 5:3; 9:6). Distinguished from H6459 pesel ('carved-image', polemical-idol), H1823 demuth ('likeness'), H4541 massekhah ('molten-image').
Aramaic; Dan 2:31-35; 3:1-19. 17 occurrences. Hyphenated. Used for Nebuchadnezzar's golden-image.
Used twice (Jdg 9:48; Pss 68:15 [14]). Mountain-near-Shechem. English convention.

Used (Job 3:5; 10:21,22 (twice); 12:22; 16:16; 24:17 (twice); 28:3; 34:22; 38:17; Pss 23:4; 44:20 [19]; 107:10,14; Isa 9:1 [2]; Jer 2:6; 13:16; Am 5:8). 18 occurrences. Hyphenated. The famous Ps 23:4 'valley of death-shadow' usage. The Hebrew is bipartite tsel (shadow) + maveth (death). KJV/ESV 'shadow of death'; modern translations sometimes 'deep darkness'. Concordant 'death-shadow' preserves the bipartite analysis.
Used twice (Num 33:41,42). Wilderness station. English convention.
Midianite king (Jdg 8:5-21; Ps 83:12 [11]). 12 occurrences. English convention.
Used twice (Jos 18:28; 2Sa 21:14). Place in Benjamin. English convention.
